test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All roses are lilies.

No lily is a marigold.

Conclusions:

(I) All lilies are roses.

(II) No rose is a marigold.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ef25ba91b5021174dc7f5d1ea86ce99aa1ff52d8820aa2722de4f90008d6160.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f254c0569a0781a5996bc434ffe8c5a62d639dd10e68ef4c3fc11a275ca8195e.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All lilies are roses → Does not follow (As all roses are lilies. So it is possible but not definite.)

(II) No rose is a marigold → Follow (As all roses are lilies and no lily is a marigold. As whole roses comes in lilies which cannot be marigold, therefore it is true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
